newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-TRAINER HERN TO QUIT.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-TRAINER HERN TO QUIT.

text.p: Former royal racehorse trainer Major Dick Hern is to retire from the sport at the end of the season.

Wheelchair-bound Hern has won 17 classics and was champion trainer four times. His most successful horse was Brigadier Gerard, who won 17 of his 18 starts in the early 1970s. His three Derby winners were Henbit, Troy and Nashwan.
The 76-year-old, a former rider, became involved in training in 1952 and began training for the Queen in 1967, enjoying a 22-year association with his royal patron.
